text:
neha: Spiking a proposal to avoid 'paper debt' -- we need concrete acceptance criteria for marking a tranche done. Sketched approach: acceptance tests + metrics checks + incident-free window.

dominik: Acceptance criteria should include a measurable delta: e.g., no regression in 95th latency for 7 days, and a review note with code pointers.

akshay: Also include a 'cost delta' where applicable (if debt fix affects cost model) so we can measure unit-economics impact.

sasha: Suggest we tie the 'done' status to a checklist enforced by GH app: (1) CI eval pass, (2) reviewer approval, (3) dashboard metric shows no regressions for X runs.

maria: How long should the incident-free window be? 7d seems short for high-traffic services. Maybe make it configurable by severity: hot=14d, warm=7d, cold=3d.

neha: Good call. We'll add severity-based windows. Also want a small template for tranche description to avoid vague entries.

dominik: Can we add a 'risk label' describing rollback pain: high/medium/low? helps SRE prioritize rollback automation.

sasha: I'll add risk and rollback-mode fields to schema. Also adding 'postfix-rollback-test' hook that runs a smoke test after rollback to ensure the system is healthy.

akshay: Action items: Neha -> write acceptance criteria doc; Dominik -> define smoke tests; Sasha -> update schema; Maria -> coordinate with product on runbook language.

maria: Let's aim to have these in the pilot registry before we onboard pilot teams.

neha: I'll draft the template and share by EOD Thu.

dominik: I'll schedule a test-run with the runtime team for smoke test hooks.

akshay: One more note: audits need to be easy for SOC. Add KMS key metadata and change logs.

sasha: Noted. will include audit fields.

maria: Thanks all. We'll lock acceptance criteria next week.
